question: Let $A$ and $B$ be $2 \times 2$ matrices such that $A = \begin{pmatrix} 2 & 1 \\ 0 & 3 \end{pmatrix}$ and $B = \begin{pmatrix} x & 1 \\ 0 & y \end{pmatrix}$ and $AB = 2B$. Find all possible values of $x$ and $y$.
explanation:
$AB = \begin{pmatrix} 2x & 2 + y \\ 0 & 3y \end{pmatrix}$ and $2B = \begin{pmatrix} 2x & 2 \\ 0 & 2y \end{pmatrix}$.

Equating corresponding entries gives $2 + y = 2$ and $3y = 2y$.

Thus $y = 0$.

$x$ can be any real number.

options.A: $y=0$ and $x$ can be any real number
options.B: $x=0$ and $y$ can be any real number
